stem:
Wanda traveled on an airplane three times last year.

• In January she traveled 278 miles.
• In April she traveled 652 miles.
• In September she traveled 767 miles.

How many more miles did Wanda travel in January and April combined than she traveled in September?
visual_elements: 8 Wanda traveled on an airplane three times last year.
How many more miles did Wanda travel in January and April combined than she traveled in September?
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires straightforward addition and subtraction with no complex steps.
